statement: Invoice retrieval fails to enforce authenticated same-tenant access: a caller could read an invoice belonging to another tenant or without authentication.
evidence_for: service.fetch_invoice returns invoice data after only a may_read check (service.py:5-7)
evidence_against: may_read returns False when user.get('authenticated', False) is falsy (security_config.py:85-86)
may_read returns False when user tenant_id != invoice tenant_id (security_config.py:87-88)
fetch_invoice raises PermissionError when may_read is False (service.py:5-6)
Only one may_read definition and one call site; no bypass branch
